title: Randomized exhaustive DCP testing with positive corruption tolerance

claims.statement: For every N >= 2, n=ceil(log2 N), secret s in Z/NZ, and corruption pattern permitted by claim 4, run the randomized-block exhaustive testing algorithm in proof.md. Its total sequential work is O(2^n n^4) on every branch, and it recovers the full secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. The exact growth index is 1.

For the same randomized-block exhaustive testing algorithm, peak allocated classical space is O(2^n n) bits for every N, s, and corruption pattern permitted by claim 4. This includes the per-round Fisher-Yates permutation array and all candidate counters. Its exact growth index is 1.

For the same randomized-block exhaustive testing algorithm, peak allocated quantum space is O(n^2) qubits for every N, s, and corruption pattern permitted by claim 4. This includes the source state, arithmetic ancillas, and reusable circuit workspace. Its exact growth index is 0.

For the same randomized-block exhaustive testing algorithm, the total number Q of fresh DCP source copies acquired on every branch is O(2^n n^2) for every N, s, and corruption pattern permitted by claim 4. This counts all rounds, discarded copies, and unsuccessful tests. Its exact growth index is 1.

For every N >= 2, n=ceil(log2 N), and secret s, the algorithm in proof.md succeeds with probability greater than 2/3 when at most floor(Q/1024) of the Q acquired positions are malformed. The adversary fixes the corrupted positions and their product-state replacements independently of the algorithm's secret random permutations and measurement outcomes; all other positions are independent ideal DCP states. Malformed copies may be arbitrary single-copy density operators and may depend on s, but may not be entangled with other positions.

structured.error_model: Among Q acquired positions, at most floor(Q/1024) may be malformed. An adversary fixes their positions and arbitrary product-state replacements independently of the algorithm's secret random permutations and measurement outcomes; it may know the secret. All other positions are independent ideal DCP coset states. Corrupted copies are not entangled with other positions.
